# Angel E. Strizioli

> Senior Full-Stack & Applied AI Engineer. 8+ years building web, mobile and backend systems across retail, fintech and media/live streaming. I lead teams as tech lead and principal engineer, setting architecture and standards and mentoring engineers, and I work AI-first with Claude Code and GitHub Copilot in daily production delivery. Currently pursuing a Master's in Artificial Intelligence at UDESA.
